Raj (Support): Escalating Riverbank trial — onboarding blocked. Customer hitting repeated 403s on embeddings ingest and sporadic tokenization errors. Renewal check-in in ~6w, want CS handoff and enablement plan :warning:
Sara (CS): Thanks Raj. Can you paste the account id + a concise repro? Is this affecting all requests or a subset?
Raj (Support): account_id=rbk-1129. Failing calls look like: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <key>
Response 403 { "error": "quota_exceeded" }
```
Only appears on batched ingest (50-100 docs). Single-doc calls succeed. Error spike started 2 days ago after they ramped import. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-7234
Olivia (AE): FYI this account is on a pilot plan with potential renewal. We need a plan that keeps the POC going — CS to lead enablement & temporary quota bump?
Sara (CS): Copy. @Nadia (Solutions) can you help triage batching behavior + config suggestions? Also propose a comms email to Evan to avoid churn.
Nadia (Solutions): I'll reproduce locally. Suspect batching + KV cache pressure + prefix cache TTL. Quick mitigation: reduce batch_size to 16 and enable prefix_caching=true. Sending patch suggestion to eng-runtime now.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/patch/reduce-batch-default -> canary (eta ~12m)
Raj (Support): Shared a short repro script in the ticket and attached customer logs. Evan (Customer) confirms they tried lowering batch size once but didn't see change — they used older client.
Evan (Customer): Hi team — thanks for the quick responses. We can try the smaller batch but would prefer a config change so our engineers don't need to rework ingest flow. Also worried about data loss during retries.
Sara (CS): Actionable plan: 1) Temporary quota bump for rbk-1129 for 72h (ops), 2) Nadia to validate reduced batch defaults + compatibility with their client (48h), 3) Schedule enablement call with Evan + eng/solutions (tomorrow 10am PT), 4) Draft comms to explain short-term workaround and next steps.
Olivia (AE): Agreed. I can own the renewal flag and join the call. If CS can stabilise POC we'll push renewal conversation forward.
Nadia (Solutions): Confirmed repro. Patch to runtime merges in ~8m. After canary I will run the customer's repro.
Sara (CS): Evan — can you share preferred dial-in and a minimal sample dataset we can run? Also any success criteria for the POC (latency/cost targets)?
Evan (Customer): I sent sample dataset to the ticket and prefer Zoom. Success criteria: <100ms median embed latency, < $0.0006/token cost.
Raj (Support): Ops approved a one-time quota bump to handle their current backlog. I'll attach the approval note. :white_check_mark:
Sara (CS): I'll draft the comms and the enablement agenda. Quick checklist for the thread: owner=Sara, ops-bump=approved, solutions=test+patch, call=scheduled. Will update ticket and ping again post-canary.
Olivia (AE): Thanks team. Notify me if the canary fails; I'll escalate to account execs.
Nadia (Solutions): Canary looks good so far, no 403s in 30m during test. I'll run the customer's script next and update.
Sara (CS): Closing loop: capture customer feedback after the call (short form), note any docs gaps for batched ingestion, and propose a permanent config recommendation for pilot-to-prod migration. :memo:
